method: Stream every audit observation, resolve its exact fixture and tournament context catalogs, aggregate by fixture, and verify all totals against the dataset manifest.
news_interpretation: Verified public headline availability strictly before execution-time proxy; actor exposure, beliefs, and causal attribution remain unknown. Broad tournament context does not certify direct match relevance.
source_files: Every audit shard plus contexts.jsonl.gz and split_policy.json from the referenced dataset manifest
wallet_count_interpretation: Distinct public wallets in each fixture; per-fixture counts overlap and must not be summed to estimate tournament wallets.
